variants.title: 横向连续流水线
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished 16:9 landscape 1920x1080 concept image for the FirmBuddy product animation, NOT a collage. This is a new concept inspired by the attached reference, not an edit of the UI screenshot. The reference image's role is only the recognizable expert hall architecture: several concentric SEMICIRCULAR stepped terraces, many individually marked expert stations, central meeting area, and brand backdrop. Remove every person and human silhouette from that reference; keep its amphitheater and labeled expert-podium identity. Preserve dozens of EMPTY expert stations (about 40-56 visible, no numeric count promise), not a few generic gears.
Art direction: an exquisite mechanical engineering blueprint drawn in ivory white drafting lines on deep Prussian-blue cyanotype paper. Rich but understated visible paper grain, subtle exposure variation, fixed large fold traces, faint drafting grid. Clear hierarchy of line weights, pale-blue section hatching, bolts, bearing blocks, exposed shafts, meshing gears, drive belts, structural trusses and precision rails. A single physically coherent enormous machine; continuous chassis, load bearing supports, shared transmissions and return track visibly connect its parts. Beautiful thoughtful designed machinery, readable graphic negative space, elegant restrained technical drawing. NOT floating flowchart nodes or disconnected modules linked only by thin lines; NOT cards/UI panels laid around an empty page. No realistic metal render, steampunk, neon HUD, glowing holograms, humanoids, hands or human shadows.
Product meaning: three request inlets for opportunity search, business questions and visit preparation; a library of many pre-existing organized document volumes feeds evidence to a multiple-specialty expert meeting hall; experts turn questions and evidence into useful plans, with an explicit user-confirmation lever before follow-up tasks and a visible record feedback loop. The library is already stocked; no automatic learning/training; no automatic deals or guarantees. Document conveyors and gear/shaft assemblies should make causality apparent. Keep the expert hall the visual heart, with tiers clearly recognizable from reference and small expert plaques. No company lifecycle stages or pre/mid/post listing chart. Only few exact Chinese main labels, no dense fake text; brand exact "FirmBuddy". Labels can be beside machinery as engineering callouts, avoid text on overlapping complex gears. Produce a finished concept still, not a storyboard. No camera arrows inside artwork. COMPOSITION A: a magnificent side-axonometric view of ONE long production machine across the width, filling roughly 85% of the frame on one unbroken engineered plinth. Left: three compact intake funnels and a double paper conveyor feeding a toothed sorting drum. CENTER: a large spacious five-tier semicircular expert amphitheater rises from the machine chassis, empty small podiums, nameplates, central circular deliberation table, elegant tall "FirmBuddy" wall behind it. Exposed large meshing gears underneath drive both the intake and output, so it reads as a real integrated mechanism and amphitheater combined, not theatre hovering above unrelated machine. Between intake and amphitheater, a tall sectioned knowledge magazine contains plentiful paper folders and book spines, with one evidence strip mechanically routed into meeting table. Right: a single document press with six output slots, then a small confirmation lever and record return rail running underneath the entire chassis. A smooth continuous travel from left intake, through the hall and evidence gear, to right document output is physically possible along the same beam. Leave upper margins calm. Main labels verbatim only: "商机查询", "业务答疑", "拜访准备", "专家会商", "知识库", "方案与行动", "用户确认". Very large readable central hall, paper-white thin lines, restrained warm brass pinpoints only at 3 active gear pivots, no fill rendering. This is the most coherent linear assembly design.
